candidates.body:
[P1] Let an explicit absence override the global default

A matched expectation such as `schema_url: {present: false}` can never pass: when the URL is absent this unconditional global rule emits `instrumentation_scope_schema_url_missing`, while when it is present the matched-span rule emits `unexpected_instrumentation_scope_schema_url`. Apply the global field default only when no matching signal expectation overrides that field (including the wholly absent-scope path), and add a regression with an actually absent schema URL.
candidates.evidence: The renderer always sets global `name` and `schema_url` to `{present: true}` (`_scope_policy.py` lines 29-32), and this rule evaluates those defaults for every standalone scope without consulting `_otel_scope_expectation.spans`. The matched-span rule at lines 25-32 separately evaluates `{present: false}`. The README at lines 295-298 documents `{present: false}` for name/schema_url and says defaults apply to omitted fields, but the integration test at lines 158-160 only tests `{present: false}` against a present URL, so it does not cover the impossible-to-satisfy absent case.
